panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 3 panels (A, B, C). A: Panel A is a clinical photo showing the patient's general appearance at appointment, specifically highlighting the presence of red eyebrows and hair, which is a characteristic finding of POMC deficiency. B: Panel B is a clinical photo demonstrating early-onset obesity in a patient with POMC deficiency at 1.5 years old, as noted in the figure caption. C: Panel C is a clinical photo showing the patient at 2.5 years old, showing progression of the condition, which is consistent with POMC deficiency.

panels.figure_caption: General appearance [At appointment (red eyebrows and hair) (A), at 1.5 years old (obesity) (B), at 2.5 years old (C)]
in_text_mentions: Following this initial presentation, in subsequent months, the child showed rapid increase in growth and developed obesity. At 17 months of age her weight was 16.9 kg (>97th percentile), height 80 cm (50th percentile), and head circumference 40 cm (75-90th percentile) (Figure 1A). Her eyebrows and hair were red (Figure 2). The final steroid treatment dose was 8 mg/m2/day. An informed consent form for publication was given by the parents.
